* '''PC-E1''' ([[Clumsy And Stupid (Errata)]]): PC card image of 17 December 2020<ref name="ht-L_clumsyandstupid-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0df3cc9/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/clumsyandstupid.gif clumsyandstupid.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0df3cc9 0df3cc9] (17 December 2020, “Updates”).</ref>, no errata mark; lower-left name “You Have Failed Me For The Last Time”. Text: “Plays on table. Opponent's Undercover spies are immune to Nevar Yalnal. Field Promotion is canceled if on Ozzel or opponent's [Maintenance] card. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Clumsy And Stupid (Errata 2)]]): PC card image of 3 January 2023<ref name="ht-L_clumsyandstupid-2">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/11d5d80/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/large/clumsyandstupid.gif clumsyandstupid.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11d5d80 11d5d80] (3 January 2023, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>Virtual13-Light/hires/clumsyandstupid.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/fba281d fba281d] (2 January 2023, “Remastered Sets 13 and P, and 1 AI fix.”).</ref>, no errata mark; lower-left name “You Have Failed Me For The Last Time”. What changed from the previous version: re-rendered by the PC in its remastered card style (high-resolution image committed 2 January 2023 as “Remastered Sets 13 and P”); same words. The straight apostrophes in “Opponent's” and “opponent's” are now curly ones. No errata mark. The printed errata mark (none) does not match this version's place in the release order (change 2 of this card): recorded as a [[Players Committee transcription errors#Errata marks that do not match the version (Virtual Modern)|PC transcription error]]. Text: “Plays on table. Opponent's Undercover spies are immune to Nevar Yalnal. Field Promotion is canceled if on Ozzel or opponent's [Maintenance] card. If Monnok just revealed your hand, you may place up to two cards from hand in your Used Pile.”
Versions follow Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error.
|notes='''Blanked:''' The Players Committee cut this shield from Virtual Set D with [[Virtual Set 23]] on 22 July 2024: the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit lists “•Clumsy And Stupid” under “Light Side – Cut”<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref>. The PC card data says its functions moved to other Defensive Shield cards. A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
